offering_description.value: Owns and operates out-of-home advertising displays such as billboards, transit and airport screens in the United States and Canada. Sells ad space to brands, agencies and marketers for set display periods.

primary_services.value: billboard advertising; digital display advertising; transit advertising; airport and mall advertising

customer_segment.value: B2B: brands, advertising agencies, media buyers and marketers

end_markets.value: retail; consumer packaged goods; automotive; entertainment; financial services

revenue_model.value: advertising: advertisers pay for ad space on billboards, transit and airport displays

value_chain_position.value: asset operator: owns and leases billboard structures and transit displays, sells ad space to brands and agencies

geography_served.value: North America: United States and Canada, mainly large metropolitan markets

specialization.value: related lines: static billboards, digital displays, transit and airport advertising sharing advertiser customers

distribution_channels.value: direct sales: in-house sales team selling ad space to brands and agencies; agents / brokers: media buying agencies placing campaigns for their clients

regulatory_exposure.value: medium: local zoning, sign permits and outdoor advertising rules, transit and airport operator contracts
